patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with a clear horizontal divider line, maintaining a consistent maximum content width for readability.
Section headings are consistently rendered in extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography, creating strong visual anchors and a commanding presence.
A high-contrast black and white color scheme is used throughout, with black as the dominant background and white for primary text and elements, creating a stark and modern aesthetic.
Major content sections (like the image and the 'ABOUT' block) are revealed by sliding or fading into view from the bottom as the user scrolls down the page.
Prominent, thin horizontal rule lines are used as the primary visual separators between distinct content sections and within the header and footer.

technique_notes: Content sections are designed to appear dynamically as the user scrolls, animating their vertical position and opacity to slide up and fade in from the bottom of the viewport.
The navigation bar at the top and a cookie consent banner at the bottom are sticky, remaining fixed in place as the user scrolls, ensuring constant access to navigation and policy information.
The design leverages a minimalist approach with a stark black and white palette and generous negative space to highlight large, impactful typography and key visual elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors against smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently for all elements, buttons, and containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, contributing to a clean and open layout.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic use of a stark black and white palette combined with extremely large, bold, uppercase typography for section titles, creating an almost editorial and high-impact visual experience. The initial full-screen black block before content reveals on scroll serves as a unique and dramatic entry point.
